title: I1-morning-answers-founder-2026-11-20.md.txt
body:
# escher — the founder's answers of the morning of 2026-11-20

Given by two question dialogs in the overseer session, after his «Я тут, давай вопросы разберем», answered by
2026-11-20 06:41Z. Seven forks gathered while he was away overnight; each answer is his chosen label or his typed
words, verbatim.

## 1. Skia by default (W4 of the upstream sync), asked again with the measurement
The question said that on 2026-11-19 he chose «Взять как в upstream», that the builder then measured skia's build
script running `curl` for prebuilt binaries from GitHub Releases with no checksum check found, that this is merged
and recorded as his ratified widening, and CI is green on it.

Options: return it to the opt-in features (marked recommended) · keep as upstream.

His answer, typed in place of an option: «Просто по поводу скиа я читал дискорд блица как я понял они собираются
скиа использовать как один из ключевых пакетов так что игнорировать его с самого начала это просто оттягивает
проблему слияния с апстримом, но ты на всякий ресерчни еще, модет я что то не так понял»

So skia STAYS a default as he chose on 2026-11-19, and he asked for research. The research (a read-only agent,
2026-11-20, GitHub and blitz.is read, Discord not readable) is reported to him in the same turn; any change after
it is a new word of his.

### 1a. After the research — a third dialog, answered by 2026-11-20 08:07Z
The research told him: skia is the browser app's default since blitz PR #1472 (2026-11-09) and the most complete
backend (filters and backdrop blur whole on it alone), the libraries' defaults stay on Vello, no maintainer
statement says skia replaces Vello; and, read in skia-bindings' source, the prebuilt archive is fetched by `curl`
with no verification («TODO: verify key»), a failed fetch falling back silently to a source build, with
`SKIA_BINARIES_URL=file:///…` as the crate's own way to take the archive from disk.

The question: how the fetch is handled, skia staying a default.
Options: a verified archive (marked recommended) · leave it and record the risk · build skia from source.
His answer: «Проверенный архив (Recommended)»
As the option read to him: in «Dependency and CI debts» the archive is fetched once, its checksum recorded in the
repository, CI and the local gates check the sum and point the build at the verified file through
`SKIA_BINARIES_URL`; no line of upstream's code changes; a CI step and a script per platform that builds skia, and
the sum updated by hand at each skia version move.

### When his README and backlog answers (items 2 and 3) are applied — the same dialog
The question said both belong to the wrapped chunk «README and records» and ride a CARRY on «Capability statement»
in Epoch 6, while the heading shows on GitHub now.
Options: now, by a separate small pass of the pipeline (marked recommended) · on the way, inside a coming debts
chunk · at the version's end as the route has it.
His answer: «Сейчас, отдельной правкой (Recommended)»
As the option read to him: after the chunk in flight, a short pass of its own — a route entry of one README edit
and the residual's close — ahead of «Browser's surviving mutants».

## 2. How the README states 0.3.0 closed (the builder's F1 of «README and records»)
The question gave the heading as it reads («0.3.0 — built, its cold-agent run passed», the overseer's interim
choice), 0.1.0's and 0.2.0's «done and verified», the version-end audit recorded 2026-11-19, 17 of 17 verified,
the cold-agent run passed, and the audit's mutation tier not finished (blitz-dom postponed, escher-driver stopped
at 89 of 96 with none missed).

Options: «done and verified» with a sentence from the audit (marked recommended) · «done and verified» with no
caveat · leave as it reads.

His answer, the label as offered: ««done and verified» без оговорок»

He chose against the marked recommendation. As the option read to him: exactly as 0.1.0 and 0.2.0, no sentence
about the audit; it says nothing of the unfinished mutation tier.

## 3. The citation backlog `res-xe7pyput` (the builder's F2 of «README and records»)
Options: close it as read through (marked recommended) · leave it open.
His answer: «Закрыть как прочитанный (Recommended)»

## 4. The fifteen upstream-authored files over 800 lines (F1 of «Codebase health»)
The question named `document.rs` at 3,470 lines and the others, and that each sync touches them most.
Options: keep them as upstream's (marked recommended) · offer the split upstream · split them in the fork.
His answer: «Оставить как у upstream (Recommended)»

## 5. The ninety-four upstream-authored functions over the complexity ceiling (F2 of «Codebase health»)
Options: keep them as upstream's (marked recommended) · cut the ones escher edits · cut them all in the fork.
His answer: «Оставить как у upstream (Recommended)»

## 6. Upstream's duplicated test pairs, 58 pairs / 611 lines (F1 of «Stand-test setup shared», F3 of «Codebase health»)
Options: keep them as upstream's (marked recommended) · fold them in the fork.
His answer: «Оставить как у upstream (Recommended)»

## 7. A new route entry for escher's seven integration-test files over 800 lines (F4 of «Codebase health»)
The question said a split changes the test-target set CI pins and mints new test binaries of about 145 MB each.
Options: mint no entry and keep the files (marked recommended) · mint it after «Codebase health» · mint it at the
version's end.
His answer: «Не заводить, оставить файлы (Recommended)»
